desc:
👍 LIKE + FAVORITE FOR MORE AIRCRAFT 👍

A passenger jet crashed on a tropical island—and the rescue beacon only activates when the entire aircraft is restored! ✈️

Can you and your crew wash, clean, and restore the plane before rescue arrives?

🧳 Return loose cabin items to their spots!
💧 Power wash rust, dirt, seats, wings, and engines!
💵 Earn Clean Cash and purchase powerful upgrades!
👥 Create a crew with up to 5 players!
🏝️ Restore all 8 zones and escape the island!

🖥️ PC CONTROLS
LMB — Wash
E — Pick up / Place
G — Drop item
Q — Upgrades
V — Shop

🎮 CONTROLLER
Y — Upgrades
X — Shop
B — Close / Back

Progress is for the current rescue session.
